categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Supezet Engineering Technology Corp., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of specialized equipment for the petrochemical, refining, and natural gas chemical industries. Its main business segments include petrochemical specialized equipment, refining specialized equipment, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) general contracting services, and other products and services. The company also provides integrated solutions encompassing design, manufacturing, installation, and services for energy equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced modular and integrated manufacturing technologies, including proprietary technologies such as cracking furnace modularization, rare earth heat-resistant steel furnace tube technology, and heat-resistant steel furnace tube preparation technology. It employs modular and integrated production methods for large-scale ethylene cracking furnaces and refining chemical equipment, enhancing production efficiency and product quality. The firm also invests in digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and green, low-carbon technologies to drive innovation and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily large-scale petrochemical, refining, and natural gas chemical enterprises, including major domestic and international companies such as Sinopec, PetroChina, and Linde. The company serves clients involved in large-scale refinery and petrochemical projects, providing specialized equipment and EPC services. Its products and services are recognized and utilized in over 16 countries, with a strong domestic market presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters in Shanghai and manufacturing bases in Jiangsu (Jingjiang), Zhejiang (Daishan), and other regions. It also has an international presence through its Hong Kong subsidiary and exports products to multiple countries. The domestic market accounts for over 99% of its revenue, with ongoing efforts to expand overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Supezet operates primarily in the midstream segment of the petrochemical supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of specialized equipment for petrochemical and refining plants. It also provides EPC general contracting services, covering engineering design, procurement, construction, and commissioning, thus spanning upstream to downstream project execution within the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation, green and low-carbon development, and digital transformation. It invests heavily in R&D to develop new materials, energy-efficient equipment, and intelligent manufacturing processes. Strategic collaborations with universities and industry leaders focus on breakthroughs in catalytic cracking, hydrogen metallurgy, modular design, and digital factory integration. The firm aims to enhance its core competitiveness and expand into new energy, new materials, and clean energy sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of specialized petrochemical and refining equipment, EPC general contracting services, and related products and services. The company operates on a project-based sales model, with revenues recognized upon completion and acceptance of equipment and services. It also benefits from government subsidies and occasional investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Supezet is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of large-scale petrochemical and refining specialized equipment with advanced modular and integrated manufacturing capabilities. It holds a strong market position with significant sales scale and technological leadership in China, competing with other major domestic and international equipment suppliers. The company has received multiple national awards and certifications, reinforcing its competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.96 billion, a slight increase of 0.78% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 153.98 million, down 18.75%. Total assets stood at about RMB 7.65 billion with a stable asset-liability ratio of 65.23%. The company has shown steady revenue growth but faces profit margin pressures due to industry transitions and market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core competitive advantages in proprietary modularization technologies, integrated manufacturing, and intelligent equipment solutions that improve product quality, reduce construction time, and lower costs. Its focus on green, low-carbon, and digital transformation aligns with industry trends and customer demands. The firm offers comprehensive one-stop solutions with strong R&D capabilities, extensive project experience, and a robust supply chain, differentiating it from competitors.
